pain_point: Fear of buying at the wrong time - What if the market drops after I buy? Should I wait for rates to come down?
headline_pain: Should You Wait for Rate Cuts?
headline_outcome: Secure Your Price Before They Do
primary_text: "Should I wait for rates to come down?" When rates drop, every buyer on the sideline rushes in and prices jump. That's exactly what happened in 2021. The smart move? Buy off-the-plan now at current pricing. By the time you settle, rates may well be lower — and you'll have locked in a price that new buyers can't access. Truganina's industrial warehouses are selling to owner-occupiers who understand this window. Brand-new build, Princes Freeway location, and today's price secured with a deposit. Don't wait for the crowd.
description: Secure today's price with a deposit before rate cuts drive demand
